title: Match native C structure and union layouts
goal: Match a C struct or union when exchanging native aggregates; use runtime C layout on .NET 11 and verify size, alignment and offsets against the actual target ABI before calling native code.

sdk.reason: Build against .NET 11 references; exact RC2 pins record measured artifacts.
sdk.name: .NET SDK

language.reason: Canonical declared language mode; no preview syntax switch.
language.name: C#

packageAssets: Framework references/runtime; no new managed NuGet dependency.
prerequisites: Console project with unsafe blocks, matching C compiler/helper and known pointer width/ABI.
Native helper source and explicit absolute MSVC compiler/linker commands are included; no CRT or Windows SDK headers are required.
platforms: Measured Windows x64 CoreCLR, MSVC 19.51.36260.0/linker14.51.36260.0; no universal ABI, Unix, Arm, Mono or AOT claim.
stabilityLimitations: Actual RC2 verification, not final-GA proof; PIN-962 and PIN-959 remain open.
constraints: C layout is ABI-specific; validate against the actual native compiler, packing options and architecture.
Explicit older offsets remain valid for their stated ABI. Incorrect layouts are rejected without native invocation.
Union fields overlap; read only the member whose interpretation the native protocol defines. No ownership or marshalling is inferred.
